items.title: Share these readings with your care team
items.text: You should talk to your team about your readings, which were only 63.9% in the 70-180 range. Your average reading was 176.9 mg/dL, so bring this up at your next visit.

items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: You walked after only 1 of your scored meals, which is too few to see how it affects you. Walking after dinner is linked to a rise about 18.3 mg/dL smaller in sugar.

items.title: Keep dinner early
items.text: You didn't have any scored dinners that started at 8 pm or later, which is good. Having late dinners is linked to a rise about 9.2 mg/dL more in sugar.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: You averaged 14.5 hours of overnight fasting, with 100.0% of nights reaching 13 hours. Adding overnight fasting to coaching changed some numbers, but more research is needed to understand this better.
